user.title: LAN Power Manager
user.description: Subnets to scan for devices and the default account used to switch computers off. Which devices get a switch is decided later in the [LAN Power panel](/lan-power-manager) in the sidebar.

data_description.subnets: e.g. 192.168.1.0/24, 10.0.5.0/24. Detected from the Home Assistant network adapters.
data_description.username: Used for every mapped computer that has no own credentials. Leave empty to set them per device.

error.invalid_subnet: Invalid subnet: use the CIDR notation, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.
error.subnet_too_large: Too many addresses to scan: use smaller subnets (up to /20).

abort.single_instance_allowed: LAN Power Manager is already configured.

init.title: LAN Power Manager options
init.description: Devices are scanned, mapped and switched on/off in the [LAN Power panel](/lan-power-manager). Here you set the subnets, the default account and the intervals.

data.scan_interval_minutes: Full network scan every (0 = only manual)
data.poll_interval_seconds: Check state of mapped devices every
data.user_policy: If a user is logged on (Windows)

error.invalid_subnet: Invalid subnet: use the CIDR notation, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.
error.subnet_too_large: Too many addresses to scan: use smaller subnets (up to /20).

options.force: Warn, wait, then shut down closing programs

scan.name: Scan network
scan.description: Scans the configured subnets now and updates the device inventory.

shutdown.name: Shut down
shutdown.description: Shuts the computer down, whatever the default off action of its switch.

hibernate.name: Hibernate
hibernate.description: Hibernates the computer (Windows: hibernation must be enabled with powercfg /h on; Linux: needs swap set up for hibernation; not available on macOS).

suspend.name: Suspend
suspend.description: Puts the computer to sleep (Windows: if hibernation is enabled it may hibernate instead).

wake.name: Wake
wake.description: Turns the computer on with Wake-on-LAN (same as turning the switch on).
